questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells you that lanes are shifting ahead. Follow the new lane path.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Highway changes ahead and to the right.
Hiking trails ahead and to the right.
Hotel ahead and to the right.
Hospital ahead and to the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Hospital ahead and to the right.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that a hospital with emergency services is located to the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign warns you that a sharp turn is coming. Reduce your speed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The maximum safe speed for a residential area.
The maximum safe speed for an expressway exit.
The maximum safe speed for an expressway entrance.
The maximum safe speed for a work zone.

questions.correctAnswerText: The maximum safe speed for an expressway exit.
questions.explanation: This sign shows the safe speed limit for an expressway exit (in this example, 30 mph).

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Construction workers on or near the roadway.

questions.explanation: This diamond-shaped yellow warning sign alerts you that pedestrians may be crossing the road ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There is a bus stop ahead.
There is a stop sign ahead.
There is a caution sign ahead.
You must stop if other cars stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a stop sign ahead.
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells you that a stop sign is coming up ahead. Be prepared to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This diamond-shaped yellow warning sign tells you that you are approaching a divided highway.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign shows that there are multiple left turn lanes ahead. Drivers in the far left lane must turn left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A road joins from the right.
The road ahead turns sharply right, then sharply left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead turns sharply right, then sharply left.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road ahead has a sharp right turn followed by a sharp left turn.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign restricts how long you can park. You may park here for a maximum of two hours during the posted times.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a school crossing is coming up ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Look for a train station ahead.
Slow down and yield for trains.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and yield for trains.
questions.explanation: A railroad crossing is ahead. Slow down when you approach it. Trains cannot stop for cars, so you must always let them pass before crossing the tracks.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow and black warning sign marks objects or areas that may be hazardous. Avoid these areas when driving.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: An upcoming curve in the road.

questions.correctAnswerText: An upcoming curve in the road.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road ahead curves to the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Keep to the side indicated by the arrow.
You may drive in the left lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Keep to the side indicated by the arrow.
questions.explanation: This "Keep right" sign means a traffic island, median, or barrier is ahead. Drive to the right side of it.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Stop completely and check for pedestrians and cross traffic.
Slow down without coming to a complete stop.
Stop completely and wait for a green light.
Slow down and check for traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop completely and check for pedestrians and cross traffic.
questions.explanation: An eight-sided sign is always a stop sign. You must come to a complete stop and check for pedestrians and other traffic before proceeding.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow and black warning sign alerts you to an intersection coming up ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: All traffic must go straight ahead.
A road joins from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: A road joins from the right.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that an intersection is ahead with a road joining from the right side.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The overpass ahead has a low clearance.
Two lanes of traffic moving in opposite directions are about to merge.

questions.correctAnswerText: The overpass ahead has a low clearance.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that an overpass ahead has low clearance. Do not proceed if your vehicle is taller than the height shown on the sign.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Traffic flows only in the direction of the arrow.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic flows only in the direction of the arrow.
questions.explanation: This one-way sign means traffic can only move in the direction the arrow points.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Lane reduction; the right lane ends soon.
Lane reduction; the left lane ends soon.

questions.correctAnswerText: Lane reduction; the right lane ends soon.
questions.explanation: The right lane is ending ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulation sign tells drivers to stay in the right lane to avoid a hazard ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow and black warning sign alerts drivers that a fire station is nearby. Be prepared for emergency vehicles on the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulation sign means you cannot park in this area.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow and black warning sign alerts drivers to watch for buggies ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The exact speed at which you must travel to avoid a ticket.
The maximum safe driving speed under ideal road and weather conditions.
The maximum safe driving speed under all road conditions.

questions.correctAnswerText: The maximum safe driving speed under ideal road and weather conditions.
questions.explanation: A speed limit sign shows the maximum legal speed for that road. You may need to drive slower if conditions are poor. Always adjust your speed to match weather and road conditions.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulation sign tells drivers they can turn left or go straight at an intersection from this lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: That the right lane ends and traffic should merge left.

questions.correctAnswerText: That the right lane ends and traffic should merge left.
questions.explanation: The right lane is ending ahead. Drivers in the right lane must move to the left lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow and black warning sign tells drivers the road will become a divided highway soon.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulation sign shows the minimum legal speed. Do not drive slower than the speed posted.
